results.summary: Lighthouses are towers or buildings that emit light from a system of lamps and lenses to serve as beacons for maritime pilots. They were used in ancient times to guide mariners, but their use declined with the advent of electronic navigational systems. Modern lighthouses are used to assist in aerial navigation and are often illuminated by a single stationary flashing light.
